workOrders.noResult: No work order matches. Clear the search or the filters.
workOrders.search: Search by number, product or sales order

waiting.title: Waiting for a work order
waiting.hint: Sales orders that Sale sent to the factory and that still have quantity without a work order.
waiting.none: Nothing is waiting. Every quantity sent by Sale has a work order.

fields.chooseLine: Choose a line of a sales order
fields.qtyHint: Up to {{max}} {{uom}} can still be planned for this line.
fields.transferHint: Up to {{max}} {{uom}} can still be transferred.

stepDialog.startDescription: Work order {{number}}. Say who works on it and on which machine or line; the time is the moment you press Start.
stepDialog.early: The step before is not done yet. Only a Manager may start this step early, and a reason is written to the history.
stepDialog.doneDescription: Work order {{number}}: {{qty}} {{uom}} are planned. Enter how many came out good and how many were defects.
stepDialog.reopenDescription: The step goes back to Running and its quantities are cleared. Use this to correct a wrong click.

tracking.hint: The steps that wait, run or were finished today. Press Start or Done on a card.

empty.waiting: No step is waiting to start.

transfers.empty: No transfers yet. Create one from a finished work order.
transfers.noResult: No transfer matches. Clear the search or the filters.
transfers.search: Search by number, work order or product

validation.qty: Enter a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.
validation.qtyInvalid: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
validation.tooMany: This is more than is left.

errors.INVALID_STATUS: This is not possible in the current status.
errors.NO_ROUTING: This product has no production steps. Add them in the product's Routing tab first.
errors.STEP_ORDER: The step before is not done yet.
errors.STEPS_NOT_DONE: A step is still running. Finish it first.

schedule.title: Schedule this work order?
schedule.description: The plan dates are agreed and production can start.

back-to-draft.title: Move back to draft?
back-to-draft.description: The work order can be edited again.
back-to-draft.done: Work order is a draft again

start.title: Start this work order?
start.description: The work order is now in process. You can also start the first step, which does the same.

finish.title: Finish this work order?
finish.description: The produced quantity is the completed quantity of the last step. When a step is not done, give the reason.

cancel.title: Cancel this work order?
cancel.description: Production stops and its quantity goes back to the list of orders waiting for a work order.

revert.title: Go back to the previous status?
revert.description: Use this to correct a wrong click. The reason is kept in the history.

transfer.title: Transfer these finished goods?
transfer.description: The finished goods move to the warehouse.
